from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents a paper extracted from a document.
    Captures the paper's own title and which OTHER provided papers it references.
    """
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being read")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (from the known collection) that appear in this paper's reference list")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from the document that anchors this paper's title and/or its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """
    Aggregates all papers extracted from the collection of documents.
    """
    papers: list[Paper]
